senses.gloss: हहल n. (-लं) A sort of deadly poison; also हाहल and हाहाल, &c.
हाहल n. (-लं) A sort of deadly poison: also हाहाल, &c.: see हलाहल ।
हाहाल n. (-लं) A sort of deadly poison; also हाहल, &c.: see हलाहल ।
हहा m. (-हा) A Gandharba or chorister of heaven; also हाहा ।

हाहा m. (-हाः) A Gandharba, a demi-god of an inferior order, atten-
[]
dant on KUVERA and the other gods, and especially the chanter
of their praises. Ind. An interjection of surprise, grief, or pain.
E. हा alas, interjection of sorrow, हा to abandon, क्विप् aff.; or हा
interjection repeated; also with असि or असुन् aff., हाहस् m. (-हाः).
हाहस् m. (-हाः) A Gandharba. E. see the next.

हाहाकार m. (-रः)
 1. The noise or uproar of battle 2. A great lamenta-
tion or wailing, sound of grief or pity.
 E. हाहा interjection of
pain, कार making.
